name: Mailmodo
title: mailmodo.com
shortDescription: Mailmodo offers a platform for creating and sending interactive AMP emails designed to increase engagement and conversion rates. It is tailored for marketers looking to enhance their email campaigns with features like drag-and-drop editing, AI-driven copy suggestions, and robust segmentation tools. Example use case: E-commerce businesses can use Mailmodo to send personalized product recommendations and interactive promotions directly within emails.
cons: AMP emails may not render in all email clients
Higher cost compared to basic email tools
